name: mathmodel-latex-skill
title_zh: MCM/ICM 论文模板一键生成，编译前先查页边距
tagline_zh: 给 Codex 装一套竞赛论文的 LaTeX 骨架：mcmthesis/cumcmthesis 双模板。
tagline_en: Give Codex a competition-ready LaTeX pipeline: mcmthesis/cumcmthesis, XeLaTeX compile, page-count & margin.
desc_en: Generate stable and competition-style LaTeX mathematical modeling paper projects for MCM/ICM and CUMCM. Use when Codex needs to create, adapt, compile, or preflight competition paper templates for COMAP MCM/ICM, Chinese Undergraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling (CUMCM), or similar mathematical modeling submissions, including mcmthesis, cumcmthesis, XeLaTeX, latexmk, PDF page/size checks, iden
why_zh: 不是丢个模板让你自己填，而是把「生成-适配-编译-预检」串成一条流水线，连 PDF 页边距都替你查好。
why_en: It's not a bare template drop—it chains generate, adapt, compile, and preflight, even verifying PDF geometry, so the last-hour.
limit_zh: 只认 MCM/ICM 与 CUMCM 的 mcmthesis/cumcmthesis 模板。
limit_en: Only mcmthesis/cumcmthesis for MCM/ICM & CUMCM; needs XeLaTeX+latexmk locally; LaTeX-only, no Word output; custom layouts not guaranteed.
title_en: One-shot MCM/ICM LaTeX paper scaffold with PDF preflight
